30-different-color-options-for-virtual-c.name: 30 different Color Options for Virtual Cockpit and Ambient Lights

80kmph-and-120kmph-speed-chime-warning.name: 80kmph and 120kmph Speed Chime / Warning
80kmph-and-120kmph-speed-chime-warning.description: The chime that sounds at 80 and 120 km/h on cars sold in India. Turn it off to stop the chime.

acceleration-display.name: Acceleration Display
acceleration-display.description: Adds an acceleration readout to the instrument cluster display.

acoustic-confirmation-lock-unlock-sound.name: Acoustic Confirmation / Lock Unlock Sound
acoustic-confirmation-lock-unlock-sound.description: Beeps to confirm the car has locked or unlocked when you use the key remote.

adaptive-lane-guidance.name: Adaptive Lane Guidance
adaptive-lane-guidance.description: Lane Assist keeps the car centered in its lane instead of only steering back at the lane edge. Turning it on also adds the option to the multimedia menu.

air-recirculation-memory.name: Air Recirculation Memory
air-recirculation-memory.description: Remembers whether air recirculation was on or off and restores it the next time you switch on the ignition.

allow-car-settings-while-moving.name: Allow Car Settings while Moving
allow-car-settings-while-moving.description: Lets you open and change the car settings in the multimedia system while the car is moving. MIB3 multimedia systems only.

am-radio.name: AM Radio
am-radio.description: Shows or hides the AM radio band in the multimedia system.

anti-theft-alarm.name: Anti Theft Alarm
anti-theft-alarm.description: Turns on the factory anti-theft alarm.

anti-theft-alarm-system.name: Anti-Theft Alarm System
anti-theft-alarm-system.description: Turns on the factory alarm, with the horn as the alarm sound, on cars without an alarm siren. It goes off if someone opens a door, the hood or the trunk while the car is locked.

auto-climate-control-menu-option-on-info.name: Auto Climate Control Menu Option on Infotainment Screen

auto-fold-orvms-on-long-press-of-lock-bu.name: Auto Fold ORVMs on Long Press of Lock Button (Requires BCM support)
auto-fold-orvms-on-long-press-of-lock-bu.description: Folds the side mirrors in when you lock the car with the key remote.

auto-folding-mirrors.name: Auto Folding Mirrors
auto-folding-mirrors.description: Folds the side mirrors in when you lock the car with the key remote, and adds the folding option to the multimedia menu.

auto-headlights-settings.name: Auto Headlights Settings
auto-headlights-settings.description: Changes when the headlights switch on with the light switch at AUTO. Early turns them on while it is still fairly bright; Late waits until it is darker.

auto-lock-unlock.name: Auto Lock/Unlock
auto-lock-unlock.description: Locks the doors automatically once you start driving, and unlocks them when you switch off the ignition.

auto-lock-upon-exit.name: Auto Lock upon Exit
auto-lock-upon-exit.description: Locks the car by itself once you walk away with the key and all doors are closed, so you do not have to press anything.

auto-turn-on-brake-light-when-boot-is-op.name: Auto Turn ON Brake Light when Boot is Opened

auto-unlock-when-parked.name: Auto Unlock When Parked
auto-unlock-when-parked.description: Unlocks the doors when you stop and shift into P. On manual cars, the doors unlock when you switch off the engine.

auto-unlock-with-ignition.name: Auto Unlock with Ignition
auto-unlock-with-ignition.description: Unlocks the doors automatically when you switch off the ignition.

battery-capacity.name: Battery Capacity
battery-capacity.description: Tells the car the capacity of a newly fitted battery so it charges it correctly. Set Battery Type as well.

battery-type.name: Battery Type
battery-type.description: Tells the car what kind of battery is fitted after a replacement so it charges it correctly. Set Battery Capacity as well.

beats-audio.name: Beats Audio
beats-audio.description: Loads one of 16 sound tuning presets into the audio processing of newer (MIB3) multimedia systems.

blink-orvm-indicators-out-of-sync-with-f.name: Blink ORVM indicators out of sync with Front and Rear Indicators

brake-lights-when-trunk-open.name: Brake Lights when Trunk Open
brake-lights-when-trunk-open.description: Lights both rear brake lights while the tailgate is open.

canton-sound-tuning-for-amplifier-subwoo.name: Canton Sound Tuning for Amplifier / SubWoofer

central-lock-with-ignition.name: Central Lock with Ignition
central-lock-with-ignition.description: Lets the key remote lock and unlock the car while the ignition is on or the engine is running.

ch-lh-lights-variant.name: CH/LH Lights Variant
ch-lh-lights-variant.description: Chooses which lights the Coming Home and Leaving Home lights use: the low beams or the front fog lights.

change-color-theme-of-infotainment-syste.name: Change Color Theme of Infotainment System

change-startup-logo-of-infotainment-scre.name: Change Startup Logo of Infotainment Screen
change-startup-logo-of-infotainment-scre.description: Adds a sound system badge to the multimedia startup screen.

comfort-lane-change-indicator-5-flashes.name: Comfort Lane Change Indicator (5 Flashes)
comfort-lane-change-indicator-5-flashes.description: Sets how many times the indicators blink when you tap the indicator stalk to change lanes.

comfort-operation-for-sunroof.name: Comfort Operation for Sunroof
comfort-operation-for-sunroof.description: Open the sunroof by holding the unlock button on your key remote, and close it by holding the lock button.

comfort-turn-signals.name: Comfort Turn Signals
comfort-turn-signals.description: Sets how many times the indicators blink when you tap the indicator stalk to change lanes.

comfort-windows.name: Comfort Windows
comfort-windows.description: Close all the windows by holding the lock button on your key remote, and open them by holding the unlock button.

coming-home-lights-activation-type.name: Coming Home Lights Activation Type
coming-home-lights-activation-type.description: Chooses when the Coming Home lights switch on as you leave the car: when you switch off the ignition, or when you open the driver door.

coming-home-lights-operation.name: Coming Home Lights Operation
coming-home-lights-operation.description: Lights up the way when you leave the car in the dark. In Manual mode you flash the headlights before getting out with the light switch at 0; in Automatic mode they come on by themselves with the switch at AUTO.

coming-home-time.name: Coming Home Time
coming-home-time.description: Sets how many seconds the Coming Home lights stay on after you leave the car.

consumption-display-correction.name: Consumption Display Correction
consumption-display-correction.description: Corrects the fuel consumption shown on the dashboard if it differs from what you really use, from 85% to 115%.

consumption-display-units.name: Consumption Display Units
consumption-display-units.description: Chooses the units the dashboard uses for fuel consumption.

cornering-lights.name: Cornering Lights
cornering-lights.description: Uses the front fog lights to light up the area you are steering into when turning and parking. Turning it on also turns on Fog Lights When Reversing, which uses the same setting.

cornering-lights-via-front-fog-lights.name: Cornering Lights Via Front Fog Lights
cornering-lights-via-front-fog-lights.description: Uses the front fog lights to light up the area you are steering into when turning and parking.

date-display-format.name: Date Display Format
date-display-format.description: Chooses how the date is shown on the dashboard.

disable-automatic-door-unlock-on-key-rem.name: Disable Automatic Door Unlock on Key Removal
disable-automatic-door-unlock-on-key-rem.description: Unlocks the doors automatically when you switch off the ignition.

disable-ignition-running-beep-or-enable-.name: Disable Ignition Running Beep or Enable for all doors

disable-please-switch-on-the-lights-popu.name: Disable Please switch on the lights Popup
disable-please-switch-on-the-lights-popu.description: The reminder that appears on the dashboard when you start the engine with the light switch at 0. Hide it if you do not need it.

display-automatic-climate-control-fan-bl.name: Display Automatic Climate Control Fan / Blower Speed in AC Auto Mode
display-automatic-climate-control-fan-bl.description: Shows the fan speed on the climate control panel even when the climate control is set to AUTO.

display-eco-tips.name: Display Eco Tips
display-eco-tips.description: Adds the eco driving screen to the multimedia system, with statistics about your fuel consumption.

display-instantaneous-fuel-efficiency-on.name: Display Instantaneous Fuel Efficiency on MID

display-of-rpm-bar-tachometer-in-virtual.name: Display of RPM Bar / Tachometer in Virtual Cockpit

display-offroad-menu-on-infotainment.name: Display Offroad Menu on Infotainment
display-offroad-menu-on-infotainment.description: Adds the off-road information screen to the multimedia system.

display-reasons-for-unavailability-of-en.name: Display reasons for unavailability of Engine Idle Auto Start / Stop system

display-vehicle-speed-battery-voltage-on.name: Display Vehicle Speed & Battery Voltage on RCD Hidden Menu

distance-display-units.name: Distance Display Units
distance-display-units.description: Shows distances on the dashboard in kilometers or miles.

drl-activation-deactivation.name: DRL Activation/Deactivation
drl-activation-deactivation.description: Keeps your car visible during the day. Choose the dedicated DRL lamps, use the position or low-beam lights instead, or turn the daytime lights off.

drl-off-with-handbrake.name: DRL Off with Handbrake
drl-off-with-handbrake.description: Switches off the daytime running lights while the handbrake is on, so they do not stay lit when you are parked.

drl-on-with-auto.name: DRL On with AUTO
drl-on-with-auto.description: Switches off the daytime running lights when the light switch is at 0, so they only work with the switch at AUTO.

drl-on-with-parking-lights.name: DRL On with Parking Lights
drl-on-with-parking-lights.description: Keeps the front side light lamps at full DRL brightness when the position or parking lights are on, instead of dimming them.

drl-onoff-control-in-infotainment-settin.name: DRL ON/OFF control in Infotainment Settings

drl-settings-in-multimedia.name: DRL Settings in Multimedia
drl-settings-in-multimedia.description: Adds an option to turn the daytime running lights on or off to the light settings in the multimedia system.

drl-with-fog-lights.name: DRL with Fog Lights
drl-with-fog-lights.description: Turns the front fog lights on together with the daytime running lights, at full brightness.

dynamic-steering-weight.name: Dynamic Steering Weight
dynamic-steering-weight.description: Sets how much the power steering helps you turn the wheel. Lower values make the steering feel heavier.

dynaudio-sound-signature-for-amplifier.name: Dynaudio Sound Signature for Amplifier
dynaudio-sound-signature-for-amplifier.description: Loads one of 16 sound tuning presets into the audio processing of newer (MIB3) multimedia systems.

easy-convenient-entry-and-exit-for-drive.name: Easy / Convenient Entry and Exit for Driver and Passenger Seats
easy-convenient-entry-and-exit-for-drive.description: Moves the front passenger seat to make getting in and out easier, and adds the setting to the multimedia menu.

easy-convenient-entry-and-exit-for-drive.name: Easy / Convenient Entry and Exit for Driver Seat
easy-convenient-entry-and-exit-for-drive.description: Moves the driver's seat to make getting in and out easier when you open the driver door, and adds the setting to the multimedia menu.

easy-entry.name: Easy Entry
easy-entry.description: Moves the driver's seat to make getting in and out easier when you open the driver door, and adds the setting to the multimedia menu.

easy-entry-for-passenger.name: Easy Entry For Passenger
easy-entry-for-passenger.description: Moves the front passenger seat to make getting in and out easier, and adds the setting to the multimedia menu.

efficiency-assist-display.name: Efficiency Assist Display
efficiency-assist-display.description: Adds the eco driving screen to the multimedia system, with statistics about your fuel consumption.

electronic-differential-lock-interaction.name: Electronic Differential Lock Interaction
electronic-differential-lock-interaction.description: XDS brakes the inner wheel in fast corners for better grip and less understeer. Choose how strongly it steps in, or turn it off.

emergency-braking-lights.name: Emergency Braking Lights
emergency-braking-lights.description: Warns drivers behind you when you brake hard, by flashing the brake lights, the turn signals, or both.

emergency-stop-signal-flashing-panic-bra.name: Emergency Stop Signal (Flashing Panic Braking Lights)
emergency-stop-signal-flashing-panic-bra.description: Switches on the hazard lights automatically when you brake hard.

engine-oil-temperature-in-mid.name: Engine Oil Temperature in MID
engine-oil-temperature-in-mid.description: Adds an engine oil temperature view to the instrument cluster, so you can see when the engine is warmed up.

engine-oil-type.name: Engine Oil Type
engine-oil-type.description: Matches the oil service reminder to the oil you use. Regular uses fixed intervals; LongLife adjusts the interval to how you drive and should only be used with LongLife oil.

engine-start-stop-button-pulsation.name: Engine Start Stop Button Pulsation
engine-start-stop-button-pulsation.description: Makes the light in the engine Start/Stop button pulse while the engine is off. It stops once the engine starts.

enhanced-brake-assist-response-early-act.name: Enhanced Brake Assist Response (Early Activation)
enhanced-brake-assist-response-early-act.description: Sets how early brake assist adds extra braking force when you brake suddenly in an emergency.

esc-asr-deactivation.name: ESC/ASR Deactivation
esc-asr-deactivation.description: Chooses which stability control (ESC) and traction control (ASR) options appear in the car menu, so you can switch them off or pick ESC Sport when you need to.

settingLabels.menu-05: ESC On / ASR Off / ESC Off
settingLabels.menu-06: ESC On / ESC Sport / ESC Off
settingLabels.menu-07: ESC On / ASR Off / ESC Off (alternative)
settingLabels.menu-08: ESC On / ESC Sport / ESC Off (alternative)
settingLabels.menu-09: ESC On / ASR Off / ESC Sport
settingLabels.menu-0a: ESC On / ASR Off / ESC Sport (alternative)

fan-level-display-when-auto.name: Fan Level Display when AUTO
fan-level-display-when-auto.description: Shows the fan speed on the climate control panel even when the climate control is set to AUTO.

fog-lights-with-flash-to-pass.name: Fog Lights with Flash-To-Pass
fog-lights-with-flash-to-pass.description: Flashes the front fog lights together with the headlights when you pull the stalk to flash other drivers.

fog-lights-with-high-beam.name: Fog Lights with High Beam
fog-lights-with-high-beam.description: Turns the front fog lights on together with the high beams.

fogs-off-with-high-beams.name: Fogs Off with High Beams
fogs-off-with-high-beams.displayName: Fog Lights Off with High Beam
fogs-off-with-high-beams.description: Switches the front fog lights off while the high beam is on. Cannot be used together with Fog Lights with High Beam or Fog Lights with Headlight Flash.

front-fog-lights-on-flash-along-with-hea.name: Front fog lights ON / Flash along with headlights
front-fog-lights-on-flash-along-with-hea.description: Lets the front fog lights stay on together with the high beams.

front-fog-lights-when-reversing.name: Front Fog Lights when Reversing
front-fog-lights-when-reversing.description: Switches on the front fog lights when you select reverse, to help you see obstacles around the car.

front-windshield-heater-duration.name: Front Windshield Heater Duration
front-windshield-heater-duration.description: Sets how long the heated front windshield stays on before it switches off by itself.

gauge-test-needle-sweep.name: Gauge Test - Needle Sweep
gauge-test-needle-sweep.description: Sweeps the instrument needles across their full range each time you switch on the ignition. For instrument clusters with physical needles.

refusals.reason: not verified on the digital Virtual Cockpit (no physical needles); the main write was never sent, so this is not an ECU refusal

green-engineering-menu-discover.name: Green Engineering Menu Discover
green-engineering-menu-discover.description: Unlocks the hidden developer menu in the multimedia system, which shows technical details about the unit.

haldex-awd-settings.name: Haldex AWD Settings
haldex-awd-settings.description: Sets how the all-wheel drive shares power with the rear wheels: more for extra grip, or less for a quieter drive.

hazard-switch-brightness.name: Hazard Switch Brightness
hazard-switch-brightness.description: Sets how brightly the hazard light switch glows while the ignition is on, from 0% (off) to 100%.

headlight-notification.name: Headlight Notification
headlight-notification.description: The reminder that appears on the dashboard when you start the engine with the light switch at 0. Hide it if you do not need it.

headlight-washer.name: Headlight Washer
headlight-washer.description: Sets after how many windshield washes the headlight washers spray as well. A lower number cleans the headlights more often.

headlight-washer-activation-count.name: Headlight Washer Activation Count
headlight-washer-activation-count.description: Sets the number of windshield washes after which the headlight washers spray too.

headlight-washer-activation-delay.name: Headlight Washer Activation Delay
headlight-washer-activation-delay.description: Sets how long you hold the washer stalk before the headlight washers spray too.

headlight-washer-activation-time.name: Headlight Washer Activation Time
headlight-washer-activation-time.description: Sets how long each headlight wash lasts, which changes how much washer fluid is used.

heated-seats-memory.name: Heated Seats Memory
heated-seats-memory.description: Remembers your seat heating setting and turns it back on after you switch the ignition off and on again.

high-beam-assist-memory.name: High Beam Assist Memory
high-beam-assist-memory.description: Remembers whether High Beam Assist was on or off when you switch off the car, and keeps that setting next time.

high-intensity-brake-light.name: High Intensity Brake Light
high-intensity-brake-light.description: Flashes the brake lights when you brake hard. When you come to a full stop, the hazard lights come on and switch off once you drive away.

hill-hold-assist.name: Hill Hold Assist
hill-hold-assist.description: Stops the car from rolling back on a slope by holding the brakes while you move your foot from the brake to the accelerator.

hill-hold-control.name: Hill Hold Control
hill-hold-control.description: Stops the car from rolling back on a slope by holding the brakes while you move your foot from the brake to the accelerator.

hill-start-assist-settings.name: Hill Start Assist Settings
hill-start-assist-settings.description: Sets when Hill Start Assist lets go of the brakes as you pull away on a slope: at lower or higher engine speed.

improve-torque-vectoring-with-xds-expand.name: Improve torque vectoring with XDS (Expanded Electronic Differential Lock)
improve-torque-vectoring-with-xds-expand.description: Turns on XDS, which brakes the inner wheel in fast corners for better grip. Pick the option that matches your engine power.

improved-ac-performance-for-better-cooli.name: Improved AC Performance for Better Cooling

indirect-tpms-tire-pressure-monitoring-s.name: Indirect TPMS (Tire Pressure Monitoring System)
indirect-tpms-tire-pressure-monitoring-s.description: Turns on tire pressure monitoring that works through the wheel speed sensors, with no sensors inside the tires.

inspection-service-distance.name: Inspection Service Distance
inspection-service-distance.description: Sets how many kilometers apart the inspection service reminders are. Check your service manual before choosing a longer interval.

inspection-service-interval.name: Inspection Service Interval
inspection-service-interval.description: Sets how much time passes between inspection service reminders. Check your service manual before choosing a longer interval.

inspection-service-reset.name: Inspection Service Reset
inspection-service-reset.description: Clears the inspection service reminder on the dashboard after the inspection is done.

instrument-cluster-lit-up-while-lights-o.name: Instrument Cluster Lit Up While Lights Off During Day

instrument-cluster-needle-sweep.name: Instrument Cluster Needle Sweep
instrument-cluster-needle-sweep.description: Sweeps the instrument needles across their full range each time you switch on the ignition. For instrument clusters with physical needles.

refusals.reason: not verified on the digital Virtual Cockpit (no physical needles); the main write was never sent, so this is not an ECU refusal

interior-light-fadein-fade-out-function-.name: Interior Light Fade-in Fade Out Function / Theatre dimming Effect

lane-assist-setting-memory.name: Lane Assist Setting Memory
lane-assist-setting-memory.description: Chooses whether Lane Assist is on or off each time you switch on the ignition, or remembers how you left it.

lane-assist-wheel-vibration.name: Lane Assist Wheel Vibration
lane-assist-wheel-vibration.description: Vibrates the steering wheel when you drift out of your lane. Turn it on or off, or choose it yourself in the multimedia menu.

lap-timer.name: Lap Timer
lap-timer.description: Adds a lap timer to the instrument cluster so you can time your laps and drives.

led-license-plate-lamps.name: LED License Plate Lamps
led-license-plate-lamps.description: Tells the car which kind of license plate bulb is fitted, so LED bulbs work properly without fault warnings.

license-plate-lights-with-drl.name: License Plate Lights with DRL
license-plate-lights-with-drl.description: Lights the number plate light whenever the daytime running lights are on.

license-plate-lights-with-hazard-lighs.name: License Plate Lights with Hazard Lighs

license-plate-lights-with-trunk-open.name: License Plate Lights with Trunk Open
license-plate-lights-with-trunk-open.displayName: Number Plate Light When Tailgate Open
license-plate-lights-with-trunk-open.description: Sets the number plate light to switch on, or switch off, while the tailgate is open. Default returns it to normal.

lock-unlock-acoustic-confirmation.name: Lock/Unlock Acoustic Confirmation
lock-unlock-acoustic-confirmation.description: Beeps to confirm the car has locked or unlocked when you use the key remote.

lock-unlock-sound-settings.name: Lock/Unlock Sound Settings
lock-unlock-sound-settings.description: Chooses whether locking and unlocking are confirmed by the horn or by a separate alarm sounder.

low-ambient-temperature-warning.name: Low Ambient Temperature Warning
low-ambient-temperature-warning.description: Sets the outside temperature at which the dashboard warns you about possible ice on the road. The factory setting is 4°C.

microphone-sensitivity.name: Microphone Sensitivity
microphone-sensitivity.description: Adjusts how sensitive the multimedia system microphone is, from -10 dB to +10 dB, for clearer sound with less background noise.

multimedia-startup-logo.name: Multimedia Startup Logo
multimedia-startup-logo.description: Changes the logo shown when the multimedia system starts. The system restarts once after the change.

settingLabels.logo-1: Skoda vRS (with stripes) / VW Twin Drive
settingLabels.logo-4: Skoda Greenline or Scout Line / VW BlueMotion
settingLabels.logo-5: Skoda or Skoda Monte Carlo / VW e-Golf

navigation-compass-in-dashboard.name: Navigation/Compass in Dashboard
navigation-compass-in-dashboard.description: Shows navigation directions or a compass in the instrument cluster.

offroad-information-screen.name: Offroad Information Screen
offroad-information-screen.description: Adds the off-road information screen to the multimedia system.

oil-change-service-distance.name: Oil Change Service Distance
oil-change-service-distance.description: Sets how many kilometers apart the oil change reminders are. Check your service manual before choosing a longer interval.

oil-change-service-interval.name: Oil Change Service Interval
oil-change-service-interval.description: Sets how much time passes between oil change reminders. Check your service manual before choosing a longer interval.

oil-service-reset.name: Oil Service Reset
oil-service-reset.description: Clears the oil change reminder on the dashboard after an oil service.

oil-temperature-display.name: Oil Temperature Display
oil-temperature-display.description: Adds an engine oil temperature view to the instrument cluster, so you can see when the engine is warmed up.

open-door-alarm.name: Open Door Alarm
open-door-alarm.description: The chime that sounds when a door is left open with the ignition on. Turn it off to silence it.

opening-and-closing-driver-side-window-d.name: Opening and Closing Driver Side Window during Unlocking and Locking car
opening-and-closing-driver-side-window-d.description: Opens and closes the driver window when you hold the unlock or lock button on your key remote.

park-assist-switch-off-speed.name: Park Assist Switch Off Speed
park-assist-switch-off-speed.description: Sets the speed at which the parking sensor display switches off by itself as you drive away, from 5 to 15 km/h.

position-lights-with-turn-signals.name: Position Lights with Turn Signals
position-lights-with-turn-signals.description: Makes the rear position lights blink together with the rear turn signals.

power-windows-with-ignition-off.name: Power Windows with Ignition Off
power-windows-with-ignition-off.description: Lets you use the driver's window for a set time (10 minutes by default) after you switch off the ignition.

pulsation-of-start-button.name: Pulsation of Start Button
pulsation-of-start-button.description: Makes the light in the engine Start/Stop button pulse while the engine is off. It stops once the engine starts.

rear-windshield-heater-duration.name: Rear Windshield Heater Duration
rear-windshield-heater-duration.description: Sets how long the rear window heater stays on before it switches off by itself, from 2 to 30 minutes.

rear-wiper-automatic-activation.name: Rear Wiper Automatic Activation
rear-wiper-automatic-activation.description: Starts the rear wiper by itself when it rains, with the front wipers on auto and the car moving at 60 km/h or faster.

refuel-quantity-in-dashboard.name: Refuel Quantity in Dashboard
refuel-quantity-in-dashboard.description: Adds a view showing how much fuel it takes to fill the tank.

remote-trunk-release.name: Remote Trunk Release
remote-trunk-release.description: Lets you open the trunk with the button on your key remote.

scandinavian-drls.name: Scandinavian DRLs
scandinavian-drls.description: Keeps the rear lights on together with the daytime running lights, as required in Scandinavian countries.

scandinavian-rear-drl.name: Scandinavian Rear DRL
scandinavian-rear-drl.description: Keeps the rear lights on together with the daytime running lights, as required in Scandinavian countries.

seat-belt-warning.name: Seat Belt Warning
seat-belt-warning.description: The warning that sounds at the start of a drive when a seat belt is not fastened.

seat-belt-warning-disable.name: Seat Belt Warning
seat-belt-warning-disable.description: The warning that sounds at the start of a drive when a seat belt is not fastened.

seat-belt-warning-type.name: Seat Belt Warning Type
seat-belt-warning-type.description: Chooses how the seat belt warning behaves. The European styles keep warning until the belt is fastened; the US style sounds 6 times and then stops.

selective-door-unlocking.name: Selective Door Unlocking
selective-door-unlocking.description: Chooses which doors unlock when you press the unlock button: all doors, only the driver door, or the doors on one side.

speed-display-units.name: Speed Display Units
speed-display-units.description: Shows speed on the instrument cluster in km/h or mph.

speed-limiter.name: Speed Limiter
speed-limiter.description: Turns on the speed limiter, which lets you set a top speed that the car will not go past.

speed-warning.name: Speed Warning
speed-warning.description: Shows a warning on the instrument cluster when you drive faster than the speed you choose, from 50 to 250 km/h.

speed-warning-for-india.name: Speed Warning for India
speed-warning-for-india.description: The chime that sounds at high speed (80 and 120 km/h) on cars sold in India. Turn it off to stop the chime.

start-stop-system-deactivation.name: Start/Stop System Deactivation
start-stop-system-deactivation.description: Start/Stop switches the engine off when you stop to save fuel. Turn it off here to keep it off every drive, instead of pressing the button each time.

steering-response.name: Steering Response
steering-response.description: Sets how light or heavy the steering feels: Comfort is lighter, Dynamic is heavier and sportier, Automatic changes with speed, or let it follow your driving mode.

taillights-when-trunk-open.name: Taillights when Trunk Open
taillights-when-trunk-open.description: Lights both rear tail lights at full brightness while the tailgate is open.

tear-drop-wiping.name: Tear Drop Wiping
tear-drop-wiping.description: After you spray the windshield, the wipers make one extra pass a few seconds later to clear the last drips.

teardrop-wiping.name: Teardrop Wiping
teardrop-wiping.description: After you spray the windshield, the wipers make one extra pass a few seconds later to clear the last drips.

temperature-display-units.name: Temperature Display Units
temperature-display-units.description: Shows temperatures on the instrument cluster in Celsius or Fahrenheit.

third-brake-light-when-trunk-open.name: Third Brake Light when Trunk Open
third-brake-light-when-trunk-open.displayName: Third Brake Light When Tailgate Open
third-brake-light-when-trunk-open.description: Lights the high-mounted third brake light at full brightness while the tailgate is open.

third-brake-light-with-coming-leaving-ho.name: Third Brake Light with Coming/Leaving Home Lights
third-brake-light-with-coming-leaving-ho.displayName: Third Brake Light with Coming Home
third-brake-light-with-coming-leaving-ho.description: Lights the third brake light while the coming home and leaving home lights are on.

third-brake-light-with-drl.name: Third Brake Light with DRL
third-brake-light-with-drl.description: Lights the third brake light dimly (10%) whenever the daytime running lights are on. Braking still lights it fully.

third-brake-light-with-hazard-lights.name: Third Brake Light with Hazard Lights

throttle-pedal-response.name: Throttle Pedal Response
throttle-pedal-response.description: Changes how the steering module switches its driving profile: gradually (Standard) or directly at a threshold (Responsive). Often described as a more direct throttle feel, but that effect is not verified.

time-display-format.name: Time Display Format
time-display-format.description: Shows the time on the instrument cluster in 24-hour or 12-hour (AM/PM) format.

top-speed-display-on-speedometer-as-280k.name: Top Speed Display on Speedometer as 280kmph

trunk-opening-closing-sound.name: Trunk Opening/Closing Sound
trunk-opening-closing-sound.description: Beeps while the power trunk opens or closes, to alert people nearby that it is moving.

turn-onoff-central-locking-using-remote-.name: Turn ON/OFF Central Locking using remote key when Engine / Ignition ON
turn-onoff-central-locking-using-remote-.description: Lets the key remote lock and unlock the car while the ignition is on or the engine is running.

turn-signals-with-ch-lh.name: Turn Signals with CH/LH
turn-signals-with-ch-lh.description: Lights both front indicators steadily at full brightness while the coming home and leaving home lights are on.

turning-off-drl-using-hedlamp-control-sw.name: Turning OFF DRL using Hedlamp Control Switch or Handbrake
turning-off-drl-using-hedlamp-control-sw.description: Switches off the daytime running lights while the handbrake is on, so they do not stay lit when you are parked.

us-style-turn-lights.name: US Style Turn Lights
us-style-turn-lights.description: The front indicators also glow dimly as side marker lights. For cars with halogen front indicators.

video-in-motion-through-pen-drive.name: Video in Motion through Pen Drive (Not Available for 2026 Facelift Models)
video-in-motion-through-pen-drive.description: Lets videos from a USB drive keep playing while the car is moving. Choose whether they always play or stop above 180 km/h.

volume-display-units.name: Volume Display Units
volume-display-units.description: Shows fuel amounts on the instrument cluster in liters or gallons.

windows-closing-after-locking.name: Windows Closing after Locking
windows-closing-after-locking.description: Close all the windows by holding the lock button on your key remote, and open them by holding the unlock button.
